top_signals.title: FBI probes Nvidia boss over alleged spy affair as shares tumble
top_signals.summary: The FBI is investigating Nvidia boss Jensen Huang’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy, Donald Trump has confirmed, as shares in the AI chip giant tumbled more than four per cent despite a wider Wall Street rally.
